description: This file implements an admission plugin for Kubernetes that manages pod priorities based on PriorityClasses. It includes registration, validation, and admission logic for PriorityClasses and Pods, ensuring correct priority assignment and enforcement of default priorities.

classes.name: Plugin
classes.description: Implements admission.Interface, MutationInterface, ValidationInterface, and initializes with Kubernetes client and lister for PriorityClasses.

methods.name: ValidateInitialization
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has a valid Kubernetes client and PriorityClass lister.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeClientSet
methods.description: Sets the Kubernetes client for the plugin.

methods.name: SetExternalKubeInformerFactory
methods.description: Initializes the PriorityClass lister and informer.

methods.name: Admit
methods.description: Handles admission requests for Pods, ensuring priority is correctly assigned.

methods.name: admitPod
methods.description: Ensures Pods do not set Priority or PreemptionPolicy directly and resolves priority from PriorityClass.

methods.name: validatePriorityClass
methods.description: Validates that only one PriorityClass is set as default and that the value is within allowed range.

methods.name: getDefaultPriorityClass
methods.description: Retrieves the default PriorityClass, handling race conditions.

methods.name: getDefaultPriority
methods.description: Returns the default priority name, value, and preemption policy.
